sections.01_executive_summary: Discovery read-only del runtime completata. PM VERDICT integrato: **MODEL A-T · EQUAL-COST TRANSITIONAL** SELECTED e DESIGN-LOCKED (flat-stat scope). Q01-Q12 tutte RESOLVED · 0 blocking open questions residue. Costi unitari DESIGN-LOCKED: Intelligenza=1.00 · Costituzione=1.00 · Destrezza=1.00 budget unit/point. Mapping IT↔runtime DESIGN-LOCKED: Intelligenza↔intellect · Costituzione↔endurance · Destrezza↔agility · Strength/Faith INELIGIBLE per CdV. Soft-cap Int 100 con effective_return=0.50 oltre cap (loadout-level, NOT_IMPLEMENTED runtime). Proc/durata/cooldown = DEFERRED (`PROC_COST_RUNTIME_DEPENDENT`, `UPTIME_MODEL_RUNTIME_DEPENDENT`). Affix eligibility cost=0. Over-budget tolerance=0 · unspent ≤5%. Legendary unique-effect ≤30% gross (derivazione 0.50×0.60). Model B NOT_SELECTED (evidence-insufficient); Model C BLOCKED_BY_EVIDENCE. Runtime extension REQUIRED prima di effect assignment: gate futuro RT1 PLANNED/HOLD/NOT_AUTHORIZED. Runtime gaps rimangono prerequisiti espliciti, NON dichiarati implementati.

07_existing_item_distribution_discovery.runtime_rarity_bonus_vs_phase_1_rarity_m: SEMANTIC_MISMATCH · runtime rarity_bonus is a flat additive at recruit; Phase 1 rarity_multiplier (1.00..1.85) is a design-layer envelope scalar for item budgets

08_soft_cap_discovery.conclusion: Soft cap 100 is a design-layer constraint. Runtime accepts arbitrary int stats; power=Σ is linear over all integer values. Any post-soft-cap treatment MUST be added as a new mechanic when applied, and requires PM ratification of a `post_soft_cap_cost` policy.

pm_verdict_Q02_post_soft_cap.clarification: L'item acquista punti nominali a 1.00, ma il loadout riceve solo 0.50 effettivo per punto oltre 100. Scaling post-cap = LOADOUT-LEVEL, NON item-level.
pm_verdict_Q02_post_soft_cap.live_readiness: nessun item pronto per live finche' non implementato+testato

10_costituzione_valuation.cost_relative_to_intelligenza_recommende: ≤_intelligenza (secondary role) but ≥_destrezza (main defensive priority for cuoio profile)

11_destrezza_valuation.blocker_rationale: Il runtime non declara una utility specifica per Destrezza differenziata da agility generico. La semantica CdV richiede che Destrezza fornisca 'utility opportunistica' NON dex-primary. Nessuna evidenza runtime per: dodge, crit, evasion, initiative, movement. Il costo unitario Destrezza in CdV non e' derivabile da runtime; richiede design layer ratifica PM.

12_model_A_equal_cost_baseline.description: Equal-cost baseline: 1 unita' budget = 1 punto stat per Int, Cost, Dex.

13_model_B_role_weighted.description: Role-weighted stat costs: Intelligenza (main) costa piu'; Costituzione (secondary) costa medio; Destrezza (tertiary) costa meno.

14_model_C_marginal_effectiveness_calibr.description: Marginal-effectiveness calibrated: costo unitario proporzionale all'effetto meccanico marginale nel runtime.
14_model_C_marginal_effectiveness_calibr.blocker_note: Il runtime attuale usa Σ lineare come power formula; NON esistono formule di damage/mitigation/proc/duration/cooldown stat-specifiche. Model C non e' calibrabile senza estensione del runtime o dichiarazione PM di formule intermedie di design.

15_model_comparison.conclusion: A resta baseline safe. B ha valore concettuale ma richiede ratifica multipliers. C blocked.
15_model_comparison.notes_post_verdict: Model A rinominato Model A-T (Equal-Cost Transitional). Model B preservato ma NOT_SELECTED. Model C BLOCKED_BY_EVIDENCE preservato.

19_effect_taxonomy_costing_methodology_1.proposed_formula_conceptual: effect_cost = base_magnitude_cost × expected_uptime_factor × reliability_factor × scope_factor × stacking_factor

20_magnitude_costing.proposed_semantics: base_magnitude_cost is the internal budget cost per canonical unit of magnitude (e.g., 1% damage boost, 1 flat stat, 1 defense point). Units MUST be normalized per category.

21_uptime_costing.proposed_semantics: expected_uptime_factor scales cost by expected active-time fraction of the effect during 30s combat window baseline.

22_proc_costing.proposed_non_linear_curve_near_cap: PM_REVIEW · proposta: quadratica sopra 30% per disincentivare accumulo
22_proc_costing.interaction_with_cooldown: internally accounted via expected_uptime_factor · non double-counting

23_duration_costing.interaction_note: durata × cooldown × magnitude MUST NOT be paid separately if expected_uptime_factor already accounts for the combined fraction. Use expected_uptime_calculation, not raw addition.

24_cooldown_costing.proposed_semantics: cooldown is inversely related to expected_uptime_factor; longer cooldown → lower uptime → lower cost per magnitude unit.
24_cooldown_costing.proposed_cost_per_second_cooldown_saved_: PM_REVIEW · proposta: -0.1 unita' budget × secondo saved

25_scope_and_reliability_factors.scope_factor_semantics: multiplier reflecting target scope: SELF=1.0 · SINGLE_TARGET=1.0 · AOE_SMALL=1.5 · AOE_LARGE=2.0 · BOSS_ONLY=0.8
25_scope_and_reliability_factors.reliability_factor_semantics: 1.0 for guaranteed effects · < 1.0 for chance-gated (already accounted via proc_costing) · > 1.0 for effects that resist common counters

26_stacking_interaction.same_family_default: NON_STACKING (ADD_WITHIN_CAP only if future record declares it)
26_stacking_interaction.stacking_penalty_for_multiple_items_same: PM_REVIEW · proposta: -20% budget per replicated family occurrence

28_utility_costing.utility_cost_methodology_baseline: same as effect_cost formula scaled by utility_share_internal_max_pct within ceiling

29_affix_costing.affix_budget_unit_semantics: PM_REVIEW · proposta: each slot consumes a fixed % of total item budget (e.g., 5% per slot up to 25% at T5)
29_affix_costing.duplicate_family_penalty_recommended: -20% effectiveness per duplicated affix family on same item
